# Third-party notices — partial coverage

This directory preserves verbatim license/notice texts from fixed upstream versions. `SOURCES.json` records source URLs, Git blob IDs when available and SHA-256 hashes. Commons Pool texts were extracted from the exact nested 2.12.0 JAR. Gradle includes this directory in `META-INF/third-party` in local builds.

Coverage: LWJGL 3.4.3 BSD notice; LMDB, Zstandard and shaderc license files distributed in the LWJGL 3.4.3 source tag; Jedis 5.1.0; lz4-java 1.8.0; XZ for Java 1.10; RocksDB 10.2.1 Apache/GPL alternative texts and LevelDB notice; Commons Pool 2.12.0 license and NOTICE. Including alternative texts does not assert that the combined port is GPL licensed. The Apache licensing route for RocksDB still requires its native third-party coverage to be checked.

**This is not a complete distribution notice bundle.** Exact native dependency revisions and full copyright/notice texts for the prebuilt shaderc/SPIRV-Cross compiler stack, and transitive components inside RocksDB/lz4/native libraries, have not been reconstructed. The generic shaderc Apache text is not a substitute for all compiler component notices. SPIRV-Cross and SPIRV-Tools texts are now included using commit prefixes embedded in the exact LWJGL macOS binaries (`6328376` and `b707790a`); glslang 16.4.0 is identified by its embedded version string. These observations do not identify every compiler dependency revision, including SPIRV-Headers. Do not infer completeness from the presence of license text or a successful build. The owner subsequently explicitly authorized experimental publication despite this open issue.

The owner reports permission from the relevant Voxy/Metal rights holders for this contribution. That permission is separate from these third-party obligations. The previous publication stop was explicitly waived by the owner; missing native provenance/notices and the optional GPL/LGPL integration questions in `docs/RIGHTS_AND_DEPENDENCIES.md` remain unresolved and disclosed.
